body: The official API server for Exllama. OAI compatible, lightweight, and fast.
plain_description: **Run fast local language models through an API for your applications.** Load and manage models, download them from Hugging Face, and serve concurrent requests. Docker images are available for NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.
technical_description: A FastAPI-based inference server and the official API backend for ExllamaV3. It supports OpenAI-compatible chat completions and tool/function calling, model loading and unloading, Hugging Face downloads, embeddings, speculative decoding, and concurrent inference. Supported model types include Exl3 and FP16/BF16.
title: TabbyAPI
